title: Governed Production full promotion dispatch bridge

phases.objective: Route an explicit governed Production promotion request through the authoritative convergence launcher rather than the legacy candidate-builder-only path.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: An authorized same-repository request PR receives DISPATCH_GOVERNED_PRODUCTION_PROMOTION or the bridge is manually dispatched with an exact request-head SHA.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The bridge proves current-main/request-tree parity and Production ancestry, dispatches the authoritative promotion launcher with exact pins and typed confirmation, and emits canonical evidence without directly mutating Production.
steps: Validate trusted commenter or typed manual request identity.
Read and pin current main, current Production, and the exact request PR head.
Require the request head to descend from and be tree-identical to current main.
Re-read all exact refs immediately before dispatch.
Dispatch governed-production-promotion-request-launcher.yml with exact main and request-head pins.
Persist the canonical dispatch decision before attempting the optional PR receipt comment.
Treat receipt-comment transport failure as non-fatal after a launcher run has been captured.
assertions: The full bridge never dispatches production-promotion-candidate.yml directly.
The launcher receives exact current main and exact tree-identical request-head SHAs.
The bridge uses bounded human or ai_policy review mode only.
A moved main, Production ref, or request head fails closed before launcher dispatch.
Canonical dispatch evidence exists independently of optional issue-comment transport.
No Production merge, deployment, migration, grant, provider mutation, credential payload read, protected-ref mutation, or force push is performed by the bridge.

phases.objective: Keep exact protected-ref and request-head currentness checks adjacent to launcher dispatch.
Fail closed on ref races and preserve successful dispatch evidence when optional receipt transport is unavailable.
This bridge grants no provider, deployment, or database mutation authority.
Final Production mutation remains outside this bridge and subject to the downstream governed release PR gates.
